_readme: Copy this to orchestra.config.json (gitignored) and fill in your values. Every key is optional; delete what you do not use. The apns_* keys are only needed for push to the iOS app — see docs/mobile/APNS-SETUP.md.
_disk: orchestra REPORTS what ~/.claude*/projects costs and never deletes any of it — retention there is yours. log_max_mb/log_keep govern ONLY the two logs orchestra writes itself (audit.log.jsonl, dispatch.log.jsonl); a rotated segment under 7 days old is never removed whatever log_keep says. `--disk-report` prints the report, `--prune-logs` runs the reap. Set disk_report_h to 0 to turn the reporting thread off.
